set.t: Look for the old grove on the 1930s aerial. Private land: ask permission. The only 1868 Newton robbery on record took about $3,500 from the county treasurer's safe on the night of 25 Feb 1868, not $40,000-50,000 from a bank; two robbers were convicted and $954 recovered. If a kettle was ever buried near State Center it held at most the missing $2,550, and no period record says so.

src: History of Jasper County, Iowa (1878), 'County Safe Robbery', pp. 388-403
